Subject: Procurement readiness & MAP — AcmeCloud

Hi John / procurement team,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for taking the time. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our discovery:

Summary of ask:
- Primary path: Procurement/PO (preferred by Acme) but option to pay by card for pilot if procurement needs more time.
- Marketplace: you indicated low interest for now (will re-evaluate later).

Procurement milestones (proposed):
1) Legal review (vendor T&Cs & DATA Addendum) — 2 weeks
2) Security review (questionnaire + SOC2 evidence) — parallel with legal, ~1–2 weeks
3) Finance vendor onboarding + PO issuance — after legal/security, ~1 week
4) PO received & payment method confirmed — target by milestone completion

Immediate asks for Acme: can you confirm the owners for Legal / Security / Finance and any specific checklist items we should surface to accelerate (e.g., AML review, PO routing instructions)? Also confirm whether procurement will accept our standard MSA or expect a counter-redline.

I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (AcmeCloud-MAP-v1.0.pdf) and a simple SOW stub to help drive the timeline — see attachments.

Proposed next step: I can update the MAP to reflect a PO-first path and share for your review by EOD. Would you be available for a 15-minute checkpoint on Friday to confirm progress?

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the MAP. A few clarifications from our side:

- Procurement route: PO is preferred for production. We can do a credit card for an initial pilot (small spend) but our SSO/vendor onboarding requires PO for anything beyond pilot.
- Marketplace: not on our vendor list today, so that won’t speed this up.
- Owners: Legal = Priya N. (legal@acmecloud.com), Security = Dan H. (security@acmecloud.com), Finance/Procurement = procurement@acmecloud.com (they handle PO issuance and vendor setup).
- Documents needed: SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 letter of attestation), completed security questionnaire (we will send the link), vendor W-9, and standard MSA/DSA.

Estimated internal timeline (rough):
- Legal review & redlines: 1–2 weeks after we receive your standard MSA and DPA
- Security review (questionnaire + SOC2 evidence): 1 week (can overlap with legal)
- Finance/vendor onboarding + PO issuance: 1 week after legal sign-off

Total realistic duration: ~3–4 weeks assuming no major commercial redlines.

Please update the MAP to indicate PO-first and include contact emails for Priya/Dan/procurement so we can route items directly. I’ll ask procurement to open the vendor registration once we confirm doc list.

Thanks,
